# dsh-restart-desktop

**A restart button for the DeepSeek Harness Desktop sidebar.**
One click fully quits the Electron ap
plication and opens it again — no tray menu, no terminal, no hunting for the window.
> 中文说明：README.zh.md
## Features
- **One click, real restart.** The whole desktop app exits and starts again — the same thing as clos

ing it from the tray and reopening it, but in one action.
- **Lives where you expect it.** A row in
the sidebar footer, directly above **Settings**; in the collapsed 56px rail it becomes a round icon

button.
- **Stays out of the way.** The button only renders when the Host reports that this is a Win

dows desktop app; in `dsh web` or on unsupported platforms it hides itself.
- **No shell windows.**
The relauncher is a detached Node process and a hidden PowerShell child; nothing flashes on screen.
- **Evidence when it fails.** Every attempt appends to `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-desktop\restart.log`, and

the launch is verified with a retry.
- **Localized.** English and Simplified Chinese UI text, displ
ay metadata for the plugin manager, and its own original icon.
## Requirements

| DeepSeek Harness | Desktop build (Electron), `dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.1` |
| OS | Windows 10/11 |
| Node |
20+ (only for development) |
The plugin is a DSH **bundle**: a Host half plus a browser half. It is not an npm dependency of your
project; it installs into a DSH profile.

## Usage

1. Find **Restart** in the sidebar footer, above **Settings**.
- Expanded sidebar: icon + `Restart`

/ `重启`.
- Collapsed rail: a round icon button with a native tooltip.
2. Click it. The page shows `Re

starting…`, the app exits after about a second, and a fresh instance opens.
3. **Running tasks are i
nterrupted.** There is no confirmation dialog — the click is the confirmation.
If the button shows `Restart failed`, wait a few seconds and try again, then read the log:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Why force-terminate?
The desktop shell turns a window close into **hide to tray**, and quitting asks the Host whether tas
ks are active before showing a confirmation dialog. `app.asar` exposes no `app.quit()` / `app.relaun
ch()` channel to plugins — the only Host-facing control messages are `quit-inspection` and `update-t
asks`, both initiated by the Electron main process.
So the only way a plugin can produce a *complete* restart is to end the application tree from **outs
ide** it and start the executable again. That is exactly what the detached helper does.
### Security
The two routes are reachable only from the same machine and the same page:

- loopback peer only (`127.0.0.1` / `::1`);
- requests carrying `Forwarded`, `X-Forwarded-For`, or `

X-Real-IP` are rejected;
- `Host` must be a loopback authority (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`),

“loopback, no Host, no Origin” shape of the desktop document proxy is accepted;
- restart requires `
POST`; `GET /dsh-restart-desktop/restart` answers `405`.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`scripts/validate.mjs` checks the manifest exports, the locale files, the icon, and the patch file w
ithout activating the plugin.
To exercise the relauncher without touching the app, point a request file at a harmless program (for
example `notepad.exe`, image `notepad`, a 200 ms delay) and run `node helper.mjs <request.json>`; t
he log shows the stop, launch, and verification steps.
### Reloading a linked checkout
A profile installed with `link:` points at your working tree. Host code is not hot-reloaded across t
hat junction, so after editing `index.js` or `helper.mjs`:
1. disable and re-enable `dsh-restart-desktop` in Settings → Plugins (or via the plugin manager), or
2. restart the app with the new button.
The browser half (`client.js`) is picked up on the next page load.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Check |
| No button in the sidebar | Is the profile the desktop one and the bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles`?

Open `/dsh-restart-desktop/status` on the app origin; `supported` must be `true`. |
| Button always
says “Restart failed” | Read `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-desktop\restart.log`. A missing `launched pid=…` l

ine means the helper could not start the executable. |
| Install fails with `timed out waiting for t
he writer lock` | A stale `package.json.lock` in the profile; restart the app so the recorded holder

PID is gone, then install again. |
| App exits but does not reopen | The log ends with `FAILED: the
application did not come back`. Start the app manually and report the log. |
